executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
The test plan's {{LOGIN_USER}}/{{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} placeholders must be replaced with different real credentials depending on which login route the test navigates to (this app has 5 separate role-scoped login pages, not one shared login):
- /admin/login -> admin@djunoeli.tn / Djunoeli2026 (SUPER_ADMIN)
- /expediteur/login -> tech@test.tn / TechZone2026 (EXPEDITEUR)
- /livreur/login -> skander@test.tn / Skander2026 (LIVREUR)
- /dispatch/login -> ali@djunoeli.tn / Ali2026 (DISPATCHER)
- /finance/login -> farah@djunoeli.tn / Farah2026 (FINANCE_MANAGER)

Note: the backend has a rate limiter of 5 login attempts per 15 minutes per account (in-memory, express-rate-limit). Avoid logging into the same account more than 4-5 times in a short span; reuse an existing authenticated session/token for a role across multiple test cases when possible instead of re-logging in every time.
